info.title: Smart Tests Intake API
info.description: API for accessing test execution data, flaky test reports, and test results

tags.name: Org Level Data View
tags.description: APIs for viewing data across workspaces using an org-level token

tags.name: Test Data View
tags.description: APIs for viewing test execution data and flaky test reports

get.description: Retrieve test execution results with filtering and pagination. Returns detailed test case execution history including status, duration, and optional logs.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start date for range query (ISO-8601: YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End date for range query (ISO-8601: YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: include-logs
parameters.description: Include test execution logs in response

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

400.description: Invalid parameters (missing test-path, invalid limit/offset, branch/test-suite not found, invalid date range)

get.summary: Get subsets of a test session
get.description: List the subsets requested in a test session, in the order they were requested, with a summary of each. Use the subset detail API for the test list of a subset.

404.description: Test session not found in the workspace

get.description: Retrieve tests that have never failed for the specified time period. Returns weekly aggregated execution statistics per test.

parameters.name: year-week
parameters.description: Specific ISO year-week to fetch (format: YYYY-Www, e.g., 2026-W15)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start date for range query (ISO-8601: YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End date for range query (ISO-8601: YYYY-MM-DD)

200.description: Successful retrieval of never-failing test data

400.description: Invalid parameters (weeks out of range 1-12, limit out of range 1-500, invalid date format)

get.description: Retrieve tests that have never failed for one or more workspaces using an org-level token. Returns weekly aggregated execution statistics per test. Results are grouped by workspace name.

parameters.name: year-week
parameters.description: Specific ISO year-week to fetch (format: YYYY-Www, e.g., 2026-W15)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start date for range query (ISO-8601: YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End date for range query (ISO-8601: YYYY-MM-DD)

200.description: Successful retrieval of never-failing test data

400.description: Invalid parameters (weeks out of range 1-12, limit out of range 1-500, invalid date format)

404.description: One or more specified workspaces not found in this organization

get.description: Retrieve monthly time savings for one or more workspaces using an org-level token. Defaults to the most recent 1 month. Use 'months' to include more recent months, or 'from'/'to' (YYYY-MM) for an explicit closed range. 'from' and 'to' must be provided together. Results are grouped by workspace name.

parameters.name: months
parameters.description: Number of recent months to include (1-24). Ignored when from/to are provided.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start year-month inclusive (YYYY-MM). Must be provided with 'to'.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End year-month inclusive (YYYY-MM). Must be provided with 'from'.

200.description: Successful retrieval of monthly time savings

400.description: Invalid date format or from > to

404.description: One or more specified workspaces not found in this organization
